score_policy: Never add or rescale DINO and Semantic scores. Evidence tiers then lexicographic ranks only.
high_A: HIGH-information speech rank<=3 and DINO frame rank<=5 for same asset; >=2 visual frames at rank<=5; source-time agreement HIGH; no timestamp warning or reverse timeline
high_B: >=2 non-overlapping HIGH-information reference queries rank<=3 for same asset; current and adjacent shot support this asset visually; observed independent speech anchor sequence HIGH; current visual/source time agreement HIGH; no strong cross-asset conflict
medium: Same asset has both modalities and source time agreement not LOW, but HIGH prerequisites fail; or strong speech with weak visual and no definite time conflict
review: DINO-only / LOW speech / strong cross-asset conflict / source-time disagreement / reversed or unverified source timeline
correlation_policy: 1/2/3-segment queries sharing any reference segment are correlated; independent query support cannot count them repeatedly. A shared speech query crossing several shots is not independent sequence evidence.
source_estimate: Interpolate independent observed speech midpoints where available; project at local 0.5–2 speed only within 15 seconds, otherwise leave null. Estimates are not cut instructions.
